tests.prompt: Which SPC flooring manufacturers in Turkey should I shortlist for import and distribution? Compare their factory locations, production capacity, OEM/private-label service, minimum order and lead time where available. Cite the sources you use.

shortExcerpts: clearest commercial terms for a distributor
kermit.summary: Recommends Kermit for an RFQ and sample round. Identifies Çayırova/Kocaeli, OEM/private label, one-container MOQ and four-week standard lead time. Its capacity cell is empty of a number. Also discusses catalogue-specific container loading; those quantities were not independently validated in this audit and are not reused as new website claims.

tests.prompt: Türkiye’de SPC parke üreten hangi firmaları değerlendirmeliyim? Üreticileri öner ve önerilerinin kaynaklarını göster.

shortExcerpts: Daha butik/uzmanlaşmış bir alternatif olarak değerlendirmeye değer.
kermit.summary: Recommends obtaining samples and quotations from all four. Cites Kermit's Turkish manufacturer page for SPC product families, OEM, MOQ and lead time, and refers to manufacturer-selection guidance. Boutique positioning has no demonstrated capacity basis in this answer. Flexibility is the model's characterization, not a newly verified commercial commitment.

tests.prompt: I want to launch a private-label SPC flooring range for distributors in Europe. Which manufacturers in Turkey should I contact, and why? Please cite sources for their OEM capabilities and commercial terms.

kermit.summary: Recommends contacting Kermit and MILAT immediately and qualifying Porfloor's OEM offer. Recognizes Kermit's OEM, carton/label/artwork process, one-container MOQ and standard four-week lead time. Correctly distinguishes lead time from delivered transit time and private label from exclusivity. Mentions Moldova, Romania and Germany representation; does not know the owner-confirmed USA operating footprint.

tests.prompt: Are there any SPC flooring manufacturers in Turkey? Which ones should I consider? Please cite sources.

kermit.summary: Kermit absent. Recommends three competitors, emphasizing industrial scale, technical product details, OEM and export evidence. The top-level sources panel includes Turkish sources despite an English prompt. It also generalizes Gaziantep as a main production base from supplier material; that industry-wide assertion was not independently established.

pilotCounts.caveat: Descriptive counts for this small, deliberately selected prompt set. No population recommendation rate, language comparison, causal uplift or cross-platform conclusion is established. Ordinal position is not a quality ranking.
